articles.title: Türkiye defends trilateral defense pact with Saudi Arabia, Pakistan
articles.titleCn: 土耳其为与沙特和巴基斯坦的三方防务协议辩护
articles.summary: Türkiye on Friday rejected claims circulated on social media that its newly signed trilateral defense agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan conflicts with NATO's Article 5.
articles.summaryCn: 土耳其否认其与沙特和巴基斯坦签署的防务协议与北约第五条冲突，并强调该协议旨在应对中东紧张局势和建立区域安全架构。

paragraphs.en:
Prime Minister of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, Prince Mohammed Bin Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, crown prince and prime minister of Saudi Arabia, and Recep Tayyip Erdogan, president of the Republic of Türkiye, pose for a group photo after signing the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement in Makkah on Friday, August 7, 2026. Türkiye on Friday {{1}} claims circulated on social media that its newly signed {{0}} defense agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan conflicts with NATO's Article 5. In a statement posted on the social media platform X, the Center for Combating Disinformation of Türkiye's Communications Directorate described the {{2}} as "entirely unfounded" and "a clearly {{3}} attempt to create a false perception."
The center said the defense agreement does not conflict with Türkiye's NATO {{6}}. NATO's Article 5 {{4}} the principle of collective defense, {{5}} that an armed attack against one member state shall be considered an attack against all members. Leaders of Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan gathered on Friday in the Saudi city of Makkah and signed the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement, which stipulates that any armed attack against one of the three countries will be considered an attack against them all.
paragraphs.cn: 巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国总理穆罕默德·夏巴兹·谢里夫、沙特阿拉伯王储兼首相穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼·阿勒沙特，以及土耳其共和国总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安，于2026年8月7日（周五）在麦加签署《麦加联合防务协议》后合影留念。土耳其周五驳斥了社交媒体上流传的说法，即其与沙特和巴基斯坦新签署的三方防务协议与北约第五条相冲突。土耳其通讯局下属的反虚假信息中心在社交媒体平台X上发布声明，称这些指控“完全毫无根据”，是“一场明显精心策划的、旨在制造错误认知的企图”。该中心表示，该防务协议与土耳其的北约承诺并不冲突。北约第五条体现了集体防御原则，规定对任一成员国的武装攻击应被视为对所有成员国的攻击。沙特、土耳其和巴基斯坦三国领导人周五在沙特城市麦加齐聚，签署了《麦加联合防务协议》，该协议规定对三国中任一国的武装攻击将被视为对全体三国的攻击。

paragraphs.en:
However, few details have been made public so far regarding the specific commitments assumed by each country, and it remains unclear to what extent the pact would require them to take concrete military action in defense of one another. Rayed Krimly, Saudi deputy minister for public diplomacy, said in a social media post that the agreement reflects the depth and longstanding nature of the strategic relations among the three countries, and represents the {{7}} of detailed negotiations conducted over a number of years. "The agreement does not represent an effort to establish a military axis or a {{8}} bloc. Nor is it linked to any nuclear {{9}} or arms race, rather it is focused on building {{10}} capabilities," he said. Pact shaped by growing Mideast tensions
Analysts argue that the decision to sign the pact at this particular moment cannot be separated from the shifting {{11}} landscape in the Middle East.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，迄今为止，关于各国承担的具体义务，公开的细节很少，该协议在多大程度上要求三国采取具体军事行动以相互防御，仍不清楚。沙特公共外交副大臣拉伊德·克里姆利在社交媒体帖子中表示，该协议反映了三国之间战略关系的深度和长期性，是多年来详细谈判的结晶。他说：“该协议并不代表建立军事轴心或教派集团的企图，也与任何核野心或军备竞赛无关，而是专注于建设可持续能力。”协议受中东紧张局势加剧影响。分析人士认为，在这一特定时刻签署该协议的决定，与中东不断变化的地缘政治格局密不可分。

paragraphs.en: The agreement's short-term goal is to address the immediate crisis of disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and heightened regional security risks amid the US-Iran conflict, said Li Zixin, a Middle East expert at the China Institute of International Studies. In the medium to long term, it aims to build an {{12}} security architecture led by defense and security cooperation among regional countries, Li said. The regional security landscape facing the three countries, particularly Saudi Arabia, has become increasingly challenging since the US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February. Saudi Arabia was reportedly targeted several times amid Iran-US conflict. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia's already strained ties with Yemen's Houthi group have sharply {{13}}, as the group has intensified attacks on Saudi targets and declared a ban on Saudi ships {{14}} the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
paragraphs.cn: 中国国际问题研究院中东问题专家李自新表示，该协议的短期目标是应对霍尔木兹海峡航运中断的紧迫危机，以及美伊冲突背景下加剧的地区安全风险。李自新说，从中长期来看，其目标是建立由地区国家防务与安全合作主导的自主安全架构。自2月美国和以色列对伊朗发动打击以来，三国，特别是沙特所面临的地区安全环境日益严峻。据报道，在伊朗与美国冲突期间，沙特多次成为袭击目标。与此同时，沙特与也门胡塞武装本已紧张的关系急剧恶化，该组织加强了对沙特目标的袭击，并宣布禁止沙特船只通过曼德海峡。

paragraphs.en: To {{15}} growing geopolitical pressures, Saudi Arabia has pursued a range of measures in recent months. Last week, the kingdom announced the formation of a multinational maritime defense {{16}} designed to safeguard vital shipping routes in the Red Sea, the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the Gulf of Aden. Despite the strong collective-defense clause, the pact's immediate operational implications remain unclear. Baris Doster, a professor of international relations at Istanbul's Marmara University, told Xinhua that he did not expect the three countries to conduct joint military maneuvers or patrols in sensitive areas such as the Strait of Hormuz, saying such a move could unnecessarily {{17}} Tehran. Noting on the deal's broader impact on both the regional security and geopolitical landscapes, Li said regional countries will not return to an era of complete reliance on US protection.
paragraphs.cn: 为应对日益增长的地缘政治压力，沙特近几个月采取了一系列措施。上周，沙特宣布组建一支多国海上防务联盟，旨在保护红海、曼德海峡和亚丁湾的重要航运路线。尽管有强大的集体防御条款，该协议的直接操作意义仍不明确。伊斯坦布尔马尔马拉大学国际关系学教授巴里斯·多斯特告诉新华社，他预计三国不会在霍尔木兹海峡等敏感地区进行联合军事演习或巡逻，称此举可能不必要地激怒德黑兰。在谈到该协议对地区安全和地缘政治格局的更广泛影响时，李自新表示，地区国家不会回到完全依赖美国保护的时代。

paragraphs.en: Instead, they are are using {{18}} mechanisms to hedge against the uncertainty of US security commitments. Bringing Pakistan into the Middle East security framework through a formalized framework also shows that regional security is no longer confined to the Middle East, but is expanding into a broader network spanning the Gulf, the Red Sea, the Arabian Sea and South Asia, Li added.
paragraphs.cn: 相反，它们正在利用制度化机制来对冲美国安全承诺的不确定性。通过正式框架将巴基斯坦纳入中东安全框架，也表明地区安全不再局限于中东，而是正在扩展为一个涵盖海湾、红海、阿拉伯海和南亚的更广泛网络，李自新补充道。

articles.fullText:
Prime Minister of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, Prince Mohammed Bin Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, crown prince and prime minister of Saudi Arabia, and Recep Tayyip Erdogan, president of the Republic of Türkiye, pose for a group photo after signing the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement in Makkah on Friday, August 7, 2026. 
Türkiye on Friday rejected claims circulated on social media that its newly signed trilateral defense agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan conflicts with NATO's Article 5.
In a statement posted on the social media platform X, the Center for Combating Disinformation of Türkiye's Communications Directorate described the allegations as "entirely unfounded" and "a clearly orchestrated attempt to create a false perception."
The center said the defense agreement does not conflict with Türkiye's NATO commitments.
NATO's Article 5 enshrines the principle of collective defense, stipulating that an armed attack against one member state shall be considered an attack against all members.
Leaders of Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan gathered on Friday in the Saudi city of Makkah and signed the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement, which stipulates that any armed attack against one of the three countries will be considered an attack against them all.
However, few details have been made public so far regarding the specific commitments assumed by each country, and it remains unclear to what extent the pact would require them to take concrete military action in defense of one another.
Rayed Krimly, Saudi deputy minister for public diplomacy, said in a social media post that the agreement reflects the depth and longstanding nature of the strategic relations among the three countries, and represents the culmination of detailed negotiations conducted over a number of years.
"The agreement does not represent an effort to establish a military axis or a sectarian bloc. Nor is it linked to any nuclear ambitions or arms race, rather it is focused on building sustainable capabilities," he said.
Pact shaped by growing Mideast tensions
Analysts argue that the decision to sign the pact at this particular moment cannot be separated from the shifting geopolitical landscape in the Middle East.
The agreement's short-term goal is to address the immediate crisis of disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and heightened regional security risks amid the US-Iran conflict, said Li Zixin, a Middle East expert at the China Institute of International Studies.
In the medium to long term, it aims to build an autonomous security architecture led by defense and security cooperation among regional countries, Li said.
The regional security landscape facing the three countries, particularly Saudi Arabia, has become increasingly challenging since the US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February.
Saudi Arabia was reportedly targeted several times amid Iran-US conflict. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia's already strained ties with Yemen's Houthi group have sharply deteriorated, as the group has intensified attacks on Saudi targets and declared a ban on Saudi ships transiting the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
To navigate growing geopolitical pressures, Saudi Arabia has pursued a range of measures in recent months. Last week, the kingdom announced the formation of a multinational maritime defense alliance designed to safeguard vital shipping routes in the Red Sea, the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the Gulf of Aden.
Despite the strong collective-defense clause, the pact's immediate operational implications remain unclear.
Baris Doster, a professor of international relations at Istanbul's Marmara University, told Xinhua that he did not expect the three countries to conduct joint military maneuvers or patrols in sensitive areas such as the Strait of Hormuz, saying such a move could unnecessarily antagonize Tehran.
Noting on the deal's broader impact on both the regional security and geopolitical landscapes, Li said regional countries will not return to an era of complete reliance on US protection. Instead, they are are using institutionalized mechanisms to hedge against the uncertainty of US security commitments.
Bringing Pakistan into the Middle East security framework through a formalized framework also shows that regional security is no longer confined to the Middle East, but is expanding into a broader network spanning the Gulf, the Red Sea, the Arabian Sea and South Asia, Li added.

articles.title: Typhoon Dolphin brings heavy rain, floods in China
articles.titleCn: 台风“海豚”带来强降雨，中国多地遭遇洪灾
articles.summary: Typhoon Dolphin brings heavy rain, floods in China
articles.summaryCn: 台风“海豚”带来的强降雨影响中国多地，北京、天津及中部和东部省份启动应急响应，并出现列车停运和洪水预警。

paragraphs.en: Heavy rain {{0}} with Typhoon Dolphin continued to affect large parts of China on Tuesday, {{1}} higher flood-control responses, train suspensions and flood warnings in Beijing and neighboring Tianjin, as well as in central and eastern provinces. Heavy rain hits Beijing, China, August 11, 2026. Beijing {{2}} a Level II flood-control emergency response, the second-highest level, at 9 a.m. Tuesday as authorities warned of heavy rain and {{3}} risks of urban flooding and landslides. Most parts of the capital are expected to receive more than 100 millimeters of rain within six hours and over 150 mm within 24 hours from Tuesday evening through Thursday, according to the Beijing meteorological service.
paragraphs.cn: 周二，与台风“海豚”相关的强降雨继续影响中国大部分地区，促使北京及邻近的天津以及中部和东部省份提高防洪应急响应、暂停列车运行并发布洪水预警。2026年8月11日，北京遭遇强降雨。周二上午9点，北京启动了二级防洪应急响应，这是第二高的级别，因为当局警告强降雨以及城市内涝和山体滑坡风险加剧。据北京市气象部门称，从周二晚上到周四，首都大部分地区预计在6小时内降雨量将超过100毫米，24小时内降雨量将超过150毫米。

paragraphs.en: The city has {{4}} more than 23,000 emergency personnel and over 2,000 sets of machinery and vehicles. It has also opened 77 elevated roads and 182 parking facilities for emergency vehicle parking in areas {{5}} to flooding. To ease travel during the rain, {{6}} bus lanes will be temporarily opened to other vehicles during Tuesday evening rush hour and throughout Wednesday and Thursday. Subway capacity will be increased, while several suburban railway services have been {{7}}. In Tianjin Municipality, marine authorities said a storm surge was expected along the coast from Tuesday afternoon through Sunday under the influence of Dolphin's outer {{8}}.
paragraphs.cn: 该市已动员超过23000名应急人员和2000多套机械设备及车辆。此外，还开放了77条高架道路和182个停车设施，供易受洪水影响地区的应急车辆停放。为缓解降雨期间的交通压力，周二晚高峰以及周三和周四全天，专用公交车道将临时向其他车辆开放。地铁运力将增加，而几条市郊铁路服务已暂停。在天津市，海洋部门表示，受“海豚”外围环流影响，从周二下午到周日，沿海地区预计将出现风暴潮。

paragraphs.en: High astronomical tides from Wednesday to Sunday could push water levels in some coastal sections to or above warning {{9}}. Rainstorm sweeps Zhengzhou, Henan Province, central China, August 11, 2026. Further south, Henan Province raised its flood-control emergency response to Level III in nine cities and the Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone from 12:30 p.m. Tuesday, while other areas remained at Level IV. The provincial meteorological observatory {{10}} its rainstorm alert from yellow to orange at 5 p.m.
paragraphs.cn: 周三至周日的高天文潮可能使部分沿海地区的水位达到或超过警戒线。2026年8月11日，中国中部河南省郑州市遭遇暴雨。再往南，河南省于周二下午12:30起在九个城市和郑州航空港经济综合实验区将防洪应急响应提升至三级，而其他地区仍保持四级。省气象台于下午5点将暴雨预警从黄色升级为橙色。

paragraphs.en: Tuesday after heavy rain had already {{11}} much of the province south of the Yellow River. Queshan County in Zhumadian City recorded the highest rainfall, at 286.6 mm over the previous 24 hours. Forecasters warned that {{12}} areas in Zhengzhou, Kaifeng and Pingdingshan could receive 250 to 350 mm of rain from 5 p.m. Tuesday to 5 p.m. Wednesday, {{13}} by short bursts of intense rainfall and localized thunderstorms and gales.
paragraphs.cn: 周二，强降雨已经浸透了黄河以南的大部分地区。驻马店市确山县录得最高降雨量，过去24小时降雨量达286.6毫米。预报员警告称，从周二下午5点到周三下午5点，郑州、开封和平顶山的个别地区降雨量可能达到250至350毫米，并伴有短时强降雨和局地雷暴大风。

paragraphs.en: Rail traffic was {{14}} in {{15}} Hubei Province, where heavy-to-{{16}} heavy rain hit central and northern areas. China Railway Wuhan Group temporarily suspended multiple services on Tuesday, including trains linking Wuhan, Hankou and Wuchang with Beijing, Xi'an and other cities. Additional temporary suspensions are expected on sections of several major railways from Tuesday through Friday. Rainstorm hits Huaibei, Anhui Province, east China, August 10, 2026. Flooding was already {{17}} in east China's Anhui Province.
paragraphs.cn: 邻近的湖北省铁路交通中断，该省中部和北部地区遭遇大到特大暴雨。中国铁路武汉局周二临时停运了多趟列车，包括连接武汉、汉口和武昌与北京、西安等城市的列车。从周二到周五，几条主要铁路的部分路段预计还会有额外的临时停运。2026年8月10日，中国东部安徽省淮北市遭遇暴雨。安徽省东部地区已出现洪涝灾害。

paragraphs.en: The Pihe River recorded its first flood of 2026 after the water level at a station in Lu'an reached its warning level early Tuesday. As of 6 a.m., five large {{18}}, 14 medium-sized reservoirs and 666 small reservoirs in Anhui were above their flood-control limits and were releasing water in {{19}} with safety procedures. In the Taihu Lake basin, the lake's water level rose to the warning mark on Tuesday, prompting authorities to {{20}} the event as Taihu's first numbered flood of the year. Dolphin, the 13th typhoon of the year, made two landfalls in Zhejiang Province on Sunday. The National Meteorological Center on Tuesday {{21}} an orange alert for rainstorms, forecasting heavy rain across a broad swath of the country through Wednesday afternoon, including Zhejiang, Shanghai, Shandong, Beijing and Tianjin.
paragraphs.cn: 淠河录得2026年首次洪水，此前六安一水文站的水位于周二凌晨达到警戒水位。截至上午6点，安徽有5座大型水库、14座中型水库和666座小型水库超过汛限水位，正在按照安全程序泄洪。在太湖流域，周二太湖水位升至警戒线，促使当局将此事件定为太湖今年首次编号洪水。“海豚”是今年第13号台风，周日两次在浙江省登陆。中央气象台周二维持暴雨橙色预警，预计到周三下午全国大范围地区将出现强降雨，包括浙江、上海、山东、北京和天津。

articles.fullText:
Heavy rain associated with Typhoon Dolphin continued to affect large parts of China on Tuesday, prompting higher flood-control responses, train suspensions and flood warnings in Beijing and neighboring Tianjin, as well as in central and eastern provinces.
Heavy rain hits Beijing, China, August 11, 2026. 
Beijing activated a Level II flood-control emergency response, the second-highest level, at 9 a.m. Tuesday as authorities warned of heavy rain and heightened risks of urban flooding and landslides.
Most parts of the capital are expected to receive more than 100 millimeters of rain within six hours and over 150 mm within 24 hours from Tuesday evening through Thursday, according to the Beijing meteorological service.
The city has mobilized more than 23,000 emergency personnel and over 2,000 sets of machinery and vehicles. It has also opened 77 elevated roads and 182 parking facilities for emergency vehicle parking in areas vulnerable to flooding.
To ease travel during the rain, designated bus lanes will be temporarily opened to other vehicles during Tuesday evening rush hour and throughout Wednesday and Thursday. Subway capacity will be increased, while several suburban railway services have been suspended.
In Tianjin Municipality, marine authorities said a storm surge was expected along the coast from Tuesday afternoon through Sunday under the influence of Dolphin's outer circulation. High astronomical tides from Wednesday to Sunday could push water levels in some coastal sections to or above warning thresholds.
Rainstorm sweeps Zhengzhou, Henan Province, central China, August 11, 2026. 
Further south, Henan Province raised its flood-control emergency response to Level III in nine cities and the Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone from 12:30 p.m. Tuesday, while other areas remained at Level IV.
The provincial meteorological observatory upgraded its rainstorm alert from yellow to orange at 5 p.m. Tuesday after heavy rain had already drenched much of the province south of the Yellow River. Queshan County in Zhumadian City recorded the highest rainfall, at 286.6 mm over the previous 24 hours.
Forecasters warned that isolated areas in Zhengzhou, Kaifeng and Pingdingshan could receive 250 to 350 mm of rain from 5 p.m. Tuesday to 5 p.m. Wednesday, accompanied by short bursts of intense rainfall and localized thunderstorms and gales.
Rail traffic was disrupted in adjacent Hubei Province, where heavy-to-exceptionally heavy rain hit central and northern areas. China Railway Wuhan Group temporarily suspended multiple services on Tuesday, including trains linking Wuhan, Hankou and Wuchang with Beijing, Xi'an and other cities. Additional temporary suspensions are expected on sections of several major railways from Tuesday through Friday.
Rainstorm hits Huaibei, Anhui Province, east China, August 10, 2026. 
Flooding was already developing in east China's Anhui Province. The Pihe River recorded its first flood of 2026 after the water level at a station in Lu'an reached its warning level early Tuesday.
As of 6 a.m., five large reservoirs, 14 medium-sized reservoirs and 666 small reservoirs in Anhui were above their flood-control limits and were releasing water in accordance with safety procedures.
In the Taihu Lake basin, the lake's water level rose to the warning mark on Tuesday, prompting authorities to designate the event as Taihu's first numbered flood of the year.
Dolphin, the 13th typhoon of the year, made two landfalls in Zhejiang Province on Sunday. The National Meteorological Center on Tuesday maintained an orange alert for rainstorms, forecasting heavy rain across a broad swath of the country through Wednesday afternoon, including Zhejiang, Shanghai, Shandong, Beijing and Tianjin.

周二，与台风“海豚”相关的强降雨继续影响中国大部分地区，促使北京及邻近的天津以及中部和东部省份提高防洪应急响应、暂停列车运行并发布洪水预警。2026年8月11日，北京遭遇强降雨。周二上午9点，北京启动了二级防洪应急响应，这是第二高的级别，因为当局警告强降雨以及城市内涝和山体滑坡风险加剧。据北京市气象部门称，从周二晚上到周四，首都大部分地区预计在6小时内降雨量将超过100毫米，24小时内降雨量将超过150毫米。

该市已动员超过23000名应急人员和2000多套机械设备及车辆。此外，还开放了77条高架道路和182个停车设施，供易受洪水影响地区的应急车辆停放。为缓解降雨期间的交通压力，周二晚高峰以及周三和周四全天，专用公交车道将临时向其他车辆开放。地铁运力将增加，而几条市郊铁路服务已暂停。在天津市，海洋部门表示，受“海豚”外围环流影响，从周二下午到周日，沿海地区预计将出现风暴潮。

周三至周日的高天文潮可能使部分沿海地区的水位达到或超过警戒线。2026年8月11日，中国中部河南省郑州市遭遇暴雨。再往南，河南省于周二下午12:30起在九个城市和郑州航空港经济综合实验区将防洪应急响应提升至三级，而其他地区仍保持四级。省气象台于下午5点将暴雨预警从黄色升级为橙色。

周二，强降雨已经浸透了黄河以南的大部分地区。驻马店市确山县录得最高降雨量，过去24小时降雨量达286.6毫米。预报员警告称，从周二下午5点到周三下午5点，郑州、开封和平顶山的个别地区降雨量可能达到250至350毫米，并伴有短时强降雨和局地雷暴大风。

邻近的湖北省铁路交通中断，该省中部和北部地区遭遇大到特大暴雨。中国铁路武汉局周二临时停运了多趟列车，包括连接武汉、汉口和武昌与北京、西安等城市的列车。从周二到周五，几条主要铁路的部分路段预计还会有额外的临时停运。2026年8月10日，中国东部安徽省淮北市遭遇暴雨。安徽省东部地区已出现洪涝灾害。

淠河录得2026年首次洪水，此前六安一水文站的水位于周二凌晨达到警戒水位。截至上午6点，安徽有5座大型水库、14座中型水库和666座小型水库超过汛限水位，正在按照安全程序泄洪。在太湖流域，周二太湖水位升至警戒线，促使当局将此事件定为太湖今年首次编号洪水。“海豚”是今年第13号台风，周日两次在浙江省登陆。中央气象台周二维持暴雨橙色预警，预计到周三下午全国大范围地区将出现强降雨，包括浙江、上海、山东、北京和天津。

articles.title: Clusters and fibers: China accelerates AI build-out
articles.titleCn: 集群与光纤：中国加速人工智能基础设施建设
articles.summary: Clusters and fibers: China accelerates AI build-out
articles.summaryCn: 中国正通过建设大规模计算集群、新型光纤和全国调度平台，加速推进人工智能基础设施建设，以提升计算能力并支持大规模模型训练。

paragraphs.en: China is {{0}} to build the computing muscle behind its AI industry, and the pieces are starting to connect. New huge {{1}} are coming online in central and southern China, a hair-thin fiber is set to {{2}} data capacity between key hubs, and more than 60% of the country's AI compute is now visible to a national {{3}} platform that entered {{4}} operation recently. China has switched on its first AI super cluster built from 100,000 {{5}} produced chips, the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) said Sunday, {{6}} a new phase in the country's push to scale up computing power. The cluster went live at the Zhengzhou node of China's national supercomputing network, in the central province of Henan, where engineers have combined traditional scientific computing with AI-focused hardware to prepare for {{8}} workloads. The system can hit {{9}} speeds {{10}} to all of humanity calculating continuously for 200 years, said Bu Jingde, chief engineer at the National High-Performance Computer Engineering Technology Research Center.
paragraphs.cn: 中国正竞相建设其人工智能产业背后的计算能力，相关环节正开始衔接。中部和南部地区的新大型集群陆续上线，一种极细光纤将把关键枢纽间的数据容量提升四倍，而全国超过60%的人工智能算力现已接入近期投入试运行的国家调度平台。国家发展改革委周日表示，中国已启用首个由10万颗国产芯片构建的人工智能超级集群，标志着该国扩大算力规模进入新阶段。该集群在位于中部河南省的郑州节点上线，隶属于国家超算互联网，工程师们将传统科学计算与人工智能专用硬件相结合，以应对新兴工作负载。国家高性能计算机工程技术研究中心首席工程师卜景德表示，该系统峰值速度相当于全人类连续计算200年。

paragraphs.en:
It is already running more than 300 computing tasks across 26 fields, including new materials, drug discovery and AI research. Cluster dedicated for AI models
A second major build-out is {{11}} in the Greater Bay Area, a southern tech hub and one of the national nodes in China's "East Data, West Computing" infrastructure plan. China Telecom has brought a new 10,000-card cluster online aimed at training the next generation of large AI models. Liu Zhijun, who leads planning for the carrier's Greater Bay Area data center, said Chinese models are moving from hundreds of billions to trillions of {{12}}, and that the new system can cut training time for a trillion-parameter model from roughly a year to about six months. China's overall AI computing capacity grew 177% year on year by the end of June, reaching 2,185 exaflops, according to NDRC figures.
paragraphs.cn: 该集群已在26个领域运行超过300项计算任务，涵盖新材料、药物发现和人工智能研究。专用于AI模型的集群：粤港澳大湾区正在推进第二个大型建设项目，该地区是南方科技中心，也是中国“东数西算”基础设施规划的国家节点之一。中国电信已上线一个新的万卡集群，旨在训练下一代大型人工智能模型。负责该运营商大湾区数据中心规划的刘志军表示，中国模型正从数千亿参数迈向数万亿参数，新系统可将万亿参数模型的训练时间从大约一年缩短至约六个月。据国家发改委数据，截至6月底，中国整体人工智能算力同比增长177%，达到2185百亿亿次浮点运算。

paragraphs.en:
The 'four-in-one' fiber
To make better use of capacity {{13}} across regions, researchers at Pengcheng Laboratory in south China's Shenzhen are developing a new type of optical fiber that packs four separate channels into a single hair-thin strand. "It is designed to break through the capacity ceiling of regular fiber," said Li Chao, an associate researcher at the lab. The team plans to deploy the new cable along a 1,000-kilometer route linking Shenzhen to southwest China's Guizhou Province, creating a national {{14}} for moving large amounts of data with minimal delay. Nationwide coordination network
More than 60% of the country's computing power is now visible to a new national {{15}} and scheduling platform in trial operation, which routes jobs to the most suitable hardware across regions. China expects the build-out to draw roughly 4 trillion yuan (about $560 billion) in new direct investment during the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030), mostly from private capital, according to Guo Mingjun, who heads the computing economy division at the NDRC's State Information Center.
paragraphs.cn: “四合一”光纤：为更好利用分散在各地区的算力，位于华南深圳的鹏城实验室研究人员正在开发一种新型光纤，将四个独立通道集成到一根发丝般细的纤芯中。“它旨在突破普通光纤的容量上限，”实验室副研究员李超表示。团队计划将新光缆部署在连接深圳与西南部贵州省的1000公里线路上，打造一条低延迟大数据传输的国家走廊。全国协调网络：目前，超过60%的全国算力已接入一个试运行的新型全国监测调度平台，该平台可将任务路由至各地区最合适的硬件。国家发改委国家信息中心算力经济部主任郭明军表示，中国预计在“十五五”规划期间（2026-2030年），该建设将吸引约4万亿元人民币（约合5600亿美元）的新直接投资，主要来自民间资本。

paragraphs.en: Funding will flow toward areas such as coordinating data centers with the power grid, and the next generation of large-scale AI clusters, he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他表示，资金将流向数据中心与电网协调、以及下一代大规模人工智能集群等领域。

articles.fullText:
China is racing to build the computing muscle behind its AI industry, and the pieces are starting to connect. New huge clusters are coming online in central and southern China, a hair-thin fiber is set to quadruple data capacity between key hubs, and more than 60% of the country's AI compute is now visible to a national scheduling platform that entered trial operation recently.
China has switched on its first AI super cluster built from 100,000 domestically produced chips, the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) said Sunday, marking a new phase in the country's push to scale up computing power.
The cluster went live at the Zhengzhou node of China's national supercomputing network, in the central province of Henan, where engineers have combined traditional scientific computing with AI-focused hardware to prepare for emerging workloads.
The system can hit peak speeds equivalent to all of humanity calculating continuously for 200 years, said Bu Jingde, chief engineer at the National High-Performance Computer Engineering Technology Research Center. It is already running more than 300 computing tasks across 26 fields, including new materials, drug discovery and AI research.
Cluster dedicated for AI models
A second major build-out is underway in the Greater Bay Area, a southern tech hub and one of the national nodes in China's "East Data, West Computing" infrastructure plan. China Telecom has brought a new 10,000-card cluster online aimed at training the next generation of large AI models.
Liu Zhijun, who leads planning for the carrier's Greater Bay Area data center, said Chinese models are moving from hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters, and that the new system can cut training time for a trillion-parameter model from roughly a year to about six months.
China's overall AI computing capacity grew 177% year on year by the end of June, reaching 2,185 exaflops, according to NDRC figures.
The 'four-in-one' fiber
To make better use of capacity scattered across regions, researchers at Pengcheng Laboratory in south China's Shenzhen are developing a new type of optical fiber that packs four separate channels into a single hair-thin strand. "It is designed to break through the capacity ceiling of regular fiber," said Li Chao, an associate researcher at the lab.
The team plans to deploy the new cable along a 1,000-kilometer route linking Shenzhen to southwest China's Guizhou Province, creating a national corridor for moving large amounts of data with minimal delay.
Nationwide coordination network
More than 60% of the country's computing power is now visible to a new national monitoring and scheduling platform in trial operation, which routes jobs to the most suitable hardware across regions.
China expects the build-out to draw roughly 4 trillion yuan (about $560 billion) in new direct investment during the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030), mostly from private capital, according to Guo Mingjun, who heads the computing economy division at the NDRC's State Information Center. Funding will flow toward areas such as coordinating data centers with the power grid, and the next generation of large-scale AI clusters, he said.

articles.title: Japanese PM repeats ambiguous stance on non-nuclear principles
articles.titleCn: 日本首相重申非核原则的模糊立场
articles.summary: Japan's Nagasaki on Sunday commemorated the 81st anniversary of the US atomic bombing of the city in the closing days of World War II. During the ceremony, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi made ambiguous remarks on Japan's non-nuclear principles, while Nagasaki Mayor Shiro Suzuki condemned nuclear weapons as an "absolute evil."
articles.summaryCn: 日本首相高市早苗在长崎原子弹爆炸纪念仪式上对非核原则的模糊表态引发争议，而长崎市长则强烈谴责核武器为“绝对邪恶”。

paragraphs.en:
Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi delivers a speech during a Nagasaki Peace Ceremony to commemorate the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing at the Peace Park in Nagasaki, Japan, August 9, 2026. Japan's Nagasaki on Sunday commemorated the 81st anniversary of the US atomic bombing of the city in the closing days of World War II. During the ceremony, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi made {{0}} remarks on Japan's non-nuclear principles, while Nagasaki Mayor Shiro Suzuki {{2}} nuclear weapons as an "{{3}} evil."
A moment of silence was {{4}} at 11:02 a.m. local time, the exact moment when a {{5}} atomic bomb dropped by a US bomber {{6}} over Nagasaki on August 9, 1945. The attack on the southwestern Japanese city came three days after the atomic bombing of Hiroshima in western Japan, and is believed to have killed around 74,000 people in Nagasaki by the end of 1945, while leaving many others suffering from long-term health effects.
paragraphs.cn: 日本首相高市早苗于2026年8月9日在日本长崎和平公园举行的长崎和平纪念仪式上发表演讲，纪念原子弹爆炸81周年。周日，日本长崎纪念了二战末期美国原子弹轰炸该市81周年。在仪式上，首相高市早苗对日本的非核原则发表了模糊言论，而长崎市长铃木史朗则谴责核武器为“绝对邪恶”。当地时间上午11点02分，人们默哀片刻，这正是1945年8月9日美国轰炸机投下的钚原子弹在长崎爆炸的时刻。对这座日本西南部城市的袭击发生在广岛原子弹爆炸三天之后，据信到1945年底，长崎约有7.4万人死亡，还有许多人遭受长期健康影响。

paragraphs.en:
The mayor of Nagasaki delivered a {{7}} at the annual memorial ceremony, calling nuclear weapons an "absolute evil" and urging the Japanese government to {{8}} its historical responsibility. He called on the Japanese government to "uphold the ethos of peace {{9}} in the Japanese constitution, which {{10}} a determination to forever renounce war, as well as the country's Three Non-Nuclear Principles."
Takaichi {{11}} her ambiguous remarks made at the Hiroshima memorial ceremony days earlier. She said that Japan "is upholding" the Three Non-Nuclear Principles, without {{12}} {{13}} that the country would continue to uphold them, marking a {{14}} {{15}} from the wording used by previous prime ministers. Japan's opposition lawmakers had previously {{16}} Takaichi's remarks as merely an explanation of the current situation, saying they lacked a clear {{17}} to maintaining the non-nuclear principles in the future. On the same day, Russian Ambassador to Japan Nikolay Nozdrev warned of the consequences of Japan abandoning its non-nuclear status in an interview with RIA Novosti.
paragraphs.cn: 长崎市长在年度纪念仪式上发表了宣言，称核武器为“绝对邪恶”，并敦促日本政府履行其历史责任。他呼吁日本政府“维护日本宪法中所体现的和平精神，该精神体现了永远放弃战争的决心，以及国家的无核三原则。”高市早苗重申了她在几天前广岛纪念仪式上发表的模糊言论。她说日本“正在维护”无核三原则，但没有明确承诺日本将继续维护这些原则，这与此前首相的措辞略有不同。日本反对党议员此前批评高市早苗的言论仅仅是对当前情况的解释，称其缺乏未来维持非核原则的明确承诺。同一天，俄罗斯驻日本大使尼古拉·诺兹德列夫在接受俄新社采访时警告了日本放弃非核地位的后果。

paragraphs.en: He said that abandoning the non-nuclear principles would {{18}} Japan's long-standing commitments as a non-nuclear state. He also warned that any Japanese move to drop its non-nuclear status would breach the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty and trigger {{19}} from countries in the region. Japan's Three Non-Nuclear Principles, which prohibit possessing, producing, or allowing the introduction of nuclear weapons into Japanese territory, were formally adopted by the Japanese parliament in 1971 and have since become the {{20}} of the country's nuclear policy. Japanese media previously reported that the Takaichi administration was considering revising the principle of not allowing the introduction of nuclear weapons into Japan as part of planned revisions to the country's three key security documents later this year. In July, Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi publicly said during an online program that Japan should discuss nuclear-related policies without taboo.
paragraphs.cn: 他表示，放弃非核原则将违反日本作为无核国家的长期承诺。他还警告说，日本任何放弃非核地位的举动都将违反《不扩散核武器条约》，并引发地区国家的反制措施。日本的无核三原则禁止拥有、生产或允许核武器进入日本领土，于1971年由日本议会正式通过，此后成为该国核政策的基石。日本媒体此前报道称，高市早苗政府正在考虑修改不允许核武器进入日本的原则，作为今年晚些时候计划修订该国三项关键安全文件的一部分。7月，防卫大臣小泉进次郎在一个在线节目中公开表示，日本应该无禁忌地讨论核相关政策。

paragraphs.en: These developments have {{21}} continued concern across Japanese society.
paragraphs.cn: 这些事态发展加剧了日本社会的持续担忧。

articles.fullText:
Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi delivers a speech during a Nagasaki Peace Ceremony to commemorate the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing at the Peace Park in Nagasaki, Japan, August 9, 2026. 
Japan's Nagasaki on Sunday commemorated the 81st anniversary of the US atomic bombing of the city in the closing days of World War II. During the ceremony, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi made ambiguous remarks on Japan's non-nuclear principles, while Nagasaki Mayor Shiro Suzuki condemned nuclear weapons as an "absolute evil."
A moment of silence was observed at 11:02 a.m. local time, the exact moment when a plutonium atomic bomb dropped by a US bomber exploded over Nagasaki on August 9, 1945.
The attack on the southwestern Japanese city came three days after the atomic bombing of Hiroshima in western Japan, and is believed to have killed around 74,000 people in Nagasaki by the end of 1945, while leaving many others suffering from long-term health effects.
The mayor of Nagasaki delivered a declaration at the annual memorial ceremony, calling nuclear weapons an "absolute evil" and urging the Japanese government to fulfill its historical responsibility.
He called on the Japanese government to "uphold the ethos of peace enshrined in the Japanese constitution, which embodies a determination to forever renounce war, as well as the country's Three Non-Nuclear Principles."
Takaichi reiterated her ambiguous remarks made at the Hiroshima memorial ceremony days earlier. She said that Japan "is upholding" the Three Non-Nuclear Principles, without explicitly pledging that the country would continue to uphold them, marking a subtle departure from the wording used by previous prime ministers.
Japan's opposition lawmakers had previously criticized Takaichi's remarks as merely an explanation of the current situation, saying they lacked a clear commitment to maintaining the non-nuclear principles in the future.
On the same day, Russian Ambassador to Japan Nikolay Nozdrev warned of the consequences of Japan abandoning its non-nuclear status in an interview with RIA Novosti.
He said that abandoning the non-nuclear principles would violate Japan's long-standing commitments as a non-nuclear state. He also warned that any Japanese move to drop its non-nuclear status would breach the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty and trigger countermeasures from countries in the region.
Japan's Three Non-Nuclear Principles, which prohibit possessing, producing, or allowing the introduction of nuclear weapons into Japanese territory, were formally adopted by the Japanese parliament in 1971 and have since become the cornerstone of the country's nuclear policy.
Japanese media previously reported that the Takaichi administration was considering revising the principle of not allowing the introduction of nuclear weapons into Japan as part of planned revisions to the country's three key security documents later this year.
In July, Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi publicly said during an online program that Japan should discuss nuclear-related policies without taboo. These developments have fueled continued concern across Japanese society.

日本首相高市早苗于2026年8月9日在日本长崎和平公园举行的长崎和平纪念仪式上发表演讲，纪念原子弹爆炸81周年。周日，日本长崎纪念了二战末期美国原子弹轰炸该市81周年。在仪式上，首相高市早苗对日本的非核原则发表了模糊言论，而长崎市长铃木史朗则谴责核武器为“绝对邪恶”。当地时间上午11点02分，人们默哀片刻，这正是1945年8月9日美国轰炸机投下的钚原子弹在长崎爆炸的时刻。对这座日本西南部城市的袭击发生在广岛原子弹爆炸三天之后，据信到1945年底，长崎约有7.4万人死亡，还有许多人遭受长期健康影响。

长崎市长在年度纪念仪式上发表了宣言，称核武器为“绝对邪恶”，并敦促日本政府履行其历史责任。他呼吁日本政府“维护日本宪法中所体现的和平精神，该精神体现了永远放弃战争的决心，以及国家的无核三原则。”高市早苗重申了她在几天前广岛纪念仪式上发表的模糊言论。她说日本“正在维护”无核三原则，但没有明确承诺日本将继续维护这些原则，这与此前首相的措辞略有不同。日本反对党议员此前批评高市早苗的言论仅仅是对当前情况的解释，称其缺乏未来维持非核原则的明确承诺。同一天，俄罗斯驻日本大使尼古拉·诺兹德列夫在接受俄新社采访时警告了日本放弃非核地位的后果。

他表示，放弃非核原则将违反日本作为无核国家的长期承诺。他还警告说，日本任何放弃非核地位的举动都将违反《不扩散核武器条约》，并引发地区国家的反制措施。日本的无核三原则禁止拥有、生产或允许核武器进入日本领土，于1971年由日本议会正式通过，此后成为该国核政策的基石。日本媒体此前报道称，高市早苗政府正在考虑修改不允许核武器进入日本的原则，作为今年晚些时候计划修订该国三项关键安全文件的一部分。7月，防卫大臣小泉进次郎在一个在线节目中公开表示，日本应该无禁忌地讨论核相关政策。

这些事态发展加剧了日本社会的持续担忧。

articles.fullText:
A Chinese commercial space debris monitoring satellite has successfully tracked and recorded the moment a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket second-stage remnant smashed into the moon, marking a significant achievement for the country's commercial space monitoring capabilities.
At around 2:35 p.m. Beijing Time (0635 GMT) on August 5, the roaming rocket body collided with the lunar surface after more than a year of orbital evolution. The event drew widespread attention from the global space community, as it offered a rare opportunity to observe the interaction between artificial objects and the lunar environment.
The space debris monitoring satellite, known as Gande-1 01, was jointly developed by the Beijing-based Aotian Technology and the Liangxi Aerospace Technology Group in Wuxi City, east China's Jiangsu Province.
At the constellation control center in Liangxi District, Wuxi City, engineers used the Tianjing monitoring platform to track the status of satellites in orbit. With support from the Purple Mountain Observatory of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Gande-1 01 successfully identified the faint Falcon 9 upper-stage object against strong background light and deep-space conditions, completing its first observation and data acquisition mission.
"We captured images of the Falcon 9 second stage heading toward the moon on August 1 and August 3. At the time of impact at around 2:35 p.m. on August 5, we recorded images of the lunar region," said Chen Long, a data processing engineer at the center. The impact was later confirmed through spectral observations conducted by overseas observatories.
Gande-1 01 tracks the Falcon 9 second stage heading toward the moon on August 1 and August 3. /CMG
Launched aboard a Lijian-1 commercial rocket on July 24, the satellite carried out the observation just over 10 days after entering orbit, tracking the lunar impact of a rocket remnant nearly 380,000 kilometers away from Earth.
As China's first commercial space debris monitoring satellite, Gande-1 01 is capable of detecting space objects across low-, medium- and high-Earth orbits. Its independently developed propulsion system allows flexible orbital maneuvers, allowing the satellite to conduct close-range observation and other complex in-orbit operations.
The satellite is also equipped with an artificial intelligence-assisted computer, enabling it to flexibly conduct routine monitoring, emergency response and rapid tracking missions, with reduced reliance on ground-based operations.
Gande-1 01 is part of the Gande constellation which will consist of 120 satellites. The constellation is expected to be fully established before 2030, forming a comprehensive space-based monitoring network.
Once completed, the system will work together with ground-based observation facilities and broader sensing networks to achieve full coverage of all-orbit target detection.
Aotian Technology said it will continue optimizing the space debris monitoring constellation construction and enhancing its ability to monitor objects in low-, medium- and high-Earth orbits, as well as near-lunar space, with high accuracy and around-the-clock coverage.

中国一颗商业太空碎片监测卫星成功追踪并记录了SpaceX猎鹰9号火箭第二级残骸撞击月球的时刻，标志着中国商业太空监测能力的重大成就。北京时间8月5日下午2点35分（格林尼治时间0635），经过一年多的轨道演变，游荡的火箭体撞击了月球表面。这一事件引起了全球太空界的广泛关注，因为它提供了一个难得的机会来观察人造物体与月球环境之间的相互作用。这颗名为“甘德一号01”的太空碎片监测卫星由北京奥天科技和位于中国东部江苏省无锡市的梁溪航天科技集团联合研制。

在无锡市梁溪区的星座控制中心，工程师使用天镜监测平台跟踪在轨卫星的状态。在中国科学院紫金山天文台的支持下，甘德一号01成功在强背景光和深空条件下识别出微弱的猎鹰9号上面级目标，完成了首次观测和数据采集任务。“我们在8月1日和8月3日捕捉到了猎鹰9号第二级飞向月球的图像。在8月5日下午2点35分左右撞击时，我们记录了月球区域的图像，”该中心的数据处理工程师陈龙说。

撞击后来通过海外天文台的频谱观测得到确认。甘德一号01在8月1日和8月3日追踪了飞向月球的猎鹰9号第二级。/中央广播电视总台
该卫星于7月24日搭载力箭一号商业火箭发射，进入轨道仅10多天后就进行了观测，追踪了距地球近38万公里的火箭残骸的月球撞击。作为中国首颗商业太空碎片监测卫星，甘德一号01能够探测低、中、高地球轨道上的太空物体。其自主研发的推进系统允许灵活的轨道机动，使卫星能够进行近距离观测和其他复杂的在轨操作。

该卫星还配备了人工智能辅助计算机，使其能够灵活执行常规监测、应急响应和快速跟踪任务，减少了对地面操作的依赖。甘德一号01是甘德星座的一部分，该星座将由120颗卫星组成。该星座预计在2030年前全面建成，形成全面的天基监测网络。一旦完成，该系统将与地面观测设施和更广泛的传感网络协同工作，实现全轨道目标探测的全面覆盖。奥天科技表示，将继续优化太空碎片监测星座建设，并增强其以高精度和全天候覆盖监测低、中、高地球轨道以及近月空间物体的能力。
